title: Warrior Class
content: Warriors are versatile melee fighters who can deal physical damage or tank. Their Arms, Fury, and Protection talent trees support weapon mastery, aggressive damage, and defensive play. Warriors build rage through combat, switch among Battle, Defensive, and Berserker Stances, and use abilities such as Charge, Taunt, and Shield Block. Protection warriors are the conventional main tanks for difficult Vanilla dungeons and raids.

title: Paladin Class
content: Paladins are Alliance holy warriors who combine melee combat with the Light. Their Holy, Protection, and Retribution talent trees support healing, tanking, and melee damage, though Vanilla raid roles commonly emphasize healing and group utility. Paladins use mana, seals, judgements, blessings, auras, cleanses, and protective abilities such as Divine Shield; Vanilla has no Holy Power resource.

title: Hunter Class
content: Hunters are ranged damage dealers who use bows, guns, or crossbows and keep ammunition in Vanilla. A trained beast can tank or add damage while the hunter tracks creatures, lays traps, kites enemies, and uses aspects for utility. Hunters use mana rather than the later Focus resource and are strong solo levelers when pet happiness, food, and ammunition are managed.

title: Rogue Class
content: Rogues are stealthy melee DPS specialists who excel at burst damage and controlling the battlefield. They can stealth, pick locks, and assassinate targets. Rogues have high mobility with abilities like sprint and vanish. They use energy as their resource and combo points to unleash powerful finishing moves. Rogues are deadly in PvP and excel at controlling fights.

title: Priest Class
content: Priests are versatile cloth spellcasters who heal through the Discipline and Holy trees or deal shadow damage through Shadow talents. They use mana and bring shields, dispels, resurrection, fear, Mind Control, and strong single-target and group healing. Racial priest spells also make a priest's race meaningful in Vanilla and Turtle WoW.

title: Shaman Class
content: Shamans are elemental spellcasters who can be healers (Restoration), melee DPS (Enhancement), or ranged DPS (Elemental). They call upon the power of elements and spirits. Shamans have totems that provide group buffs and can weapon imbue for different effects. They excel at area damage and healing, making them valuable in groups and raids.

title: Mage Class
content: Mages are powerful ranged spellcasters who deal massive damage with fire, frost, and arcane magic. They can polymorph enemies, teleport, and create portals. Mages have strong crowd control and can burst down targets quickly. They use mana as their resource and have abilities to conserve mana. Mages are glass cannons - high damage but low survivability.

title: Warlock Class
content: Warlocks are dark cloth spellcasters who summon demons and use curses, drains, damage-over-time effects, and destructive fire or shadow magic. They use mana and collect Soul Shards for summons, Healthstones, Soulstones, and other abilities. Fear, Banish, pet utility, and health-to-mana conversion give warlocks strong control and endurance.

title: Druid Class
content: Druids are shapeshifting spellcasters whose Balance, Feral Combat, and Restoration talent trees support ranged spell damage, cat damage, bear tanking, and healing. Forms change available abilities and resources: bear uses rage, cat uses energy and combo points, while caster form uses mana. Druids bring healing, battle resurrection, Innervate, crowd control, stealth, and travel utility; Vanilla has no separate Guardian specialization.

title: Vanilla and Turtle WoW Class Roster
content: Turtle WoW uses the nine Vanilla classes: Warrior, Paladin, Hunter, Rogue, Priest, Shaman, Mage, Warlock, and Druid. Death Knights, Monks, Demon Hunters, and Evokers are not playable. Race and faction restrict class choices, while Turtle WoW adds selected custom race-class combinations without adding a tenth class.

title: Alliance Faction
content: The Alliance is one of Azeroth's two player factions. Its playable peoples on Turtle WoW are Humans, Dwarves, Gnomes, Night Elves, and High Elves. Major hubs include Stormwind, Ironforge, Darnassus, and the High Elf settlement of Alah'Thalas. Alliance adventurers share quests, travel routes, guilds, and battleground teams and are hostile to the Horde in faction conflict.

title: Horde Faction
content: The Horde is one of Azeroth's two player factions. Its playable peoples on Turtle WoW are Orcs, Trolls, Tauren, Forsaken, and Goblins. Major hubs include Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, Undercity, and the Goblin port at Sparkwater. Horde adventurers share quests, travel routes, guilds, and battleground teams and are hostile to the Alliance in faction conflict.

title: Human Race
content: Humans of Stormwind are adaptable Alliance adventurers who begin in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. Their racials favor reputation gains, Spirit, stealth detection, and sword or mace skill. Human class choices cover many martial and magical roles. Standard riding begins at level 40 in this Vanilla-era ruleset, not level 20.

title: Orc Race
content: Orcs came from Draenor through the Dark Portal and form a central part of Thrall's Horde. They begin in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Their Vanilla racials include Blood Fury, Hardiness, Command, and Axe Specialization, which suit martial classes and pet users. Orc history centers on shamanism, demonic corruption, liberation, and rebuilding in Kalimdor.

title: Dwarf Race
content: Dwarves are hardy Alliance mountain folk known for craftsmanship, archaeology, and ale. They begin in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh and look to Ironforge and King Magni Bronzebeard. Stoneform, Frost Resistance, Gun Specialization, and Find Treasure are their characteristic Vanilla racials, and their class choices include strong martial, priestly, and hunting roles.

title: Night Elf Race
content: Night Elves are an ancient Alliance people devoted to Elune and the natural world. They begin in Shadowglen on Teldrassil and gather around Darnassus. Shadowmeld, Quickness, Nature Resistance, and Wisp Spirit shape their Vanilla racial identity. Druids, hunters, priests, rogues, and warriors fit their traditions, with Tyrande Whisperwind and Malfurion Stormrage central to their lore.

title: Tauren Race
content: Tauren are a spiritual Horde people of Mulgore with deep ties to the Earth Mother, nature, and the elements. They begin at Red Cloud Mesa and follow High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff. War Stomp, Endurance, Cultivation, and Nature Resistance are their characteristic Vanilla racials. Their traditions strongly suit druids, shamans, hunters, and warriors.

title: Troll Race
content: The Darkspear trolls are agile Horde survivors known for regeneration, hunting, and voodoo traditions. They begin in the Valley of Trials alongside the orcs and are led by Vol'jin. Berserking, Regeneration, Beast Slaying, and Bow or Throwing Specialization are their characteristic Vanilla racials. Trolls can pursue several martial, shamanic, priestly, and magical classes.

title: Gnome Race
content: Gnomes are ingenious Alliance inventors displaced from Gnomeregan. They begin among the dwarves in Coldridge Valley and gather in Ironforge under High Tinker Mekkatorque. Escape Artist, Expansive Mind, Arcane Resistance, and Engineering Specialization are their characteristic Vanilla racials. Their intellect and ingenuity suit mages, warlocks, rogues, and warriors.

title: Forsaken (Undead) Race
content: The Forsaken are undead people who broke free of the Lich King's control and joined the Horde under Sylvanas Windrunner. They rise in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades and rule from Undercity. Will of the Forsaken, Cannibalize, Underwater Breathing, and Shadow Resistance are their characteristic Vanilla racials. Their class choices include warriors, rogues, priests, mages, and warlocks.

title: High Elf Race
content: High Elves are a custom playable Alliance race in Turtle WoW, descended from the survivors of Quel'Thalas who did not follow the Blood Elves' path. Their story begins around the Thalassian Highlands and Alah'Thalas, and arcane tradition, ranger culture, and loyalty to the Alliance shape their quests. Available classes and racials follow the server's Vanilla-plus rules rather than Burning Crusade Blood Elf mechanics.

title: Goblin Race
content: Goblins are a custom playable Horde race in Turtle WoW. Their opening story is tied to Durotar, the South Seas, trade, engineering, and the settlements around Sparkwater Port. Goblin adventurers are practical and inventive, with available classes and racials designed for the server's Vanilla-plus rules rather than later Cataclysm mechanics.
